tools.name: taleez_list_jobs
tools.description: List the job postings of the company (id, label, status DRAFT/PUBLISHED/DONE/SUSPENDED, contract, location, recruiter, unit, tags, visibility, public URL). tools.name: taleez_get_job
tools.description: One job posting by id with its full details: descriptions, contract, location, recruiter, unit, tags, custom properties, public and application URLs. GET /0/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_steps
tools.description: The recruitment pipeline steps of a job in order (id, name, order). Use them to read where each candidate stands. GET /0/jobs/{id}/steps.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_statuses
tools.description: The status history of a job: each change (date timestamp, status DRAFT/PUBLISHED/SUSPENDED/DONE). GET /0/jobs/{id}/statuses.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_questions
tools.description: The questions candidates answer when applying to a job (id, label, type, required, choices). GET /0/jobs/{id}/questions.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_filters
tools.description: The total number of jobs and the job counts per status, contract, city, tag and company label (only values with at least one job). A quick overview of the hiring activity. GET /0/jobs/filters.

tools.name: taleez_list_job_properties
tools.description: The custom job properties defined in the account (id, name, type, choices). GET /0/job-properties.

tools.name: taleez_list_candidates
tools.description: List the candidates in the company (id, name, mail, phone, language, location, social links, unit, creation date). Filter by exact e-mail address to find one person. Custom properties only with with_props. Candidates contain personal data: use it only for the user's own recruiting. GET /0/candidates

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate
tools.description: One candidate by id: name, mail, phone, language, location, social links, unit, CV link and custom properties. GET /0/candidates/{id}.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_applications
tools.description: Where a candidate stands: every application or association (type SPONTANEOUS, APPLICATION_TO_A_JOB, ASSOCIATED_TO_A_JOB...) with the job id, current pipeline step, rejected/hired dates and the step history. GET /0/candidates/{id}/applications.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_properties
tools.description: The custom property values of a candidate (property id, name key, type, value or choices). GET /0/candidates/{id}/properties.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_pools
tools.description: The talent pools a candidate belongs to (pool id, name, date added, referrer). GET /0/candidates/{id}/pools.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_documents
tools.description: The documents attached to a candidate (CV, cover letter...): id, name, date, size and file URL. GET /0/candidates/{id}/documents.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_events
tools.description: The events (interviews, calls, meetings) scheduled with a candidate: subject, start/end, location, meeting URL, attendees. GET /0/candidates/{id}/events.

tools.name: taleez_list_candidate_properties
tools.description: The custom candidate properties defined in the account (id, name, type, choices, disabled). Use the ids with taleez_set_candidate_properties. GET /0/candidate-properties.

tools.name: taleez_list_pools
tools.description: List the talent pools of the company (id, name, dates, recruiter). GET /0/pools.

tools.name: taleez_list_pool_candidates
tools.description: The candidates in one talent pool. Custom properties only with with_props. GET /0/pools/{id}/candidates.

tools.name: taleez_list_recruiters
tools.description: List the recruiters (users) of the company. Use the ids to read who owns a job or to credit a new candidate. GET /0/recruiters.

tools.name: taleez_list_units
tools.description: List the units (entities, subsidiaries, sites) of the company. Use the ids to filter jobs. GET /0/units.

tools.name: taleez_list_events
tools.description: List the company's calendar events (interviews, meetings): subject, start/end timestamps, location, meeting URL, job id, attendees. GET /0/events.

tools.name: taleez_create_candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add a new candidate to the Taleez database (first and last name required; the e-mail, if given, must be unique in the company). Creates a record only: the candidate is not attached to a job and no e-mail is sent by this call. Not idempotent: calling twice with no mail creates two candidates.

tools.name: taleez_update_candidate
tools.description: WRITE: change a candidate's name, e-mail, phone, social links or location. The current record is read first and unchanged name, mail and phone are sent back, so only what you pass changes (Taleez' update endpoint otherwise needs first and last name). tools.description: WRITE: set custom property values on a candidate. For a property without choices pass value (DATE as yyyy-MM-dd); for a property with choices pass choices (choice ids, see taleez_list_candidate_properties). An empty choices list removes all selected choices unless append_choices is true. Overwrites

tools.name: taleez_add_candidates_to_pool
tools.description: WRITE: add existing candidates to a talent pool (see taleez_list_pools). Adding a candidate already in the pool is harmless. No message is sent. POST /0/pools/{id}/candidates.

tools.name: taleez_add_candidates_to_job
tools.description: WRITE: associate existing candidates to a job so they appear in its recruitment pipeline (the vendor's 'add candidates to a job'; this is an association made by the recruiter, not a candidate application, and this call sends no message). Pass location_id for a job with several locations. POST /0/job

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: taleez_list_jobs, taleez_get_job, taleez_get_candidate_documents, taleez_get_candidate_events, taleez_list_events, taleez_update_candidate, taleez_set_candidate_properties · Private data: taleez_get_candidate_documents, taleez_create_candidate, taleez_update_candidate · Public sink: taleez_create_candidate, taleez_update_candidate, taleez_set_candidate_properties, taleez_add_candidates_to_pool, taleez_add_candidates_to_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: taleez_list_jobs, taleez_get_job, taleez_get_candidate_documents, taleez_get_candidate_events, taleez_list_events, taleez_update_candidate, taleez_set_candidate_properties · Private data: taleez_get_candidate_documents, taleez_create_candidate, taleez_update_candidate · Public sink: taleez_create_candidate, taleez_update_candidate, taleez_set_candidate_properties, taleez_add_candidates_to_pool, taleez_add_candidates_to_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
